_readme: Single settings file for the daily job. Every value marked ESTIMATE is a placeholder: replace it with a lab/FAO-56 value, then set soil.calibrated and crop.confirmed to true. Until then decision.json says calibrated=false and the Pi gateway refuses to run valves automatically.

soil.source: ESTIMATE (textbook clay loam, FAO-56 Table 5). Replace with 105 C oven-dry core results / lab pressure plate
soil._auto_note: true = while calibrated is false, the daily job estimates theta_fc/theta_wp from SoilGrids + Saxton-Rawls (cached 60 days). Setting calibrated:true uses YOUR values below instead.

start.note: Set date + depletion_mm from a soil sample or a day after full irrigation/heavy rain (M4)

_zones_note: Run time uses area_m2 + flow_lph when both are set (measure the flow once with a bucket); otherwise rate_mm_hr (3 mm/h is the dashboard's ESTIMATE).

inputs._farmer_events_format: CSV with columns date,type,value,zone  (type = irrigated_min | rain_mm; zone = 1,2,3 or blank for all)
